g.text: Sequence Diagram 8 - Automated Reminders, Atomic Claim & Retry (FR-4.1.2, FR-4.1.3, FR-4.4.2, FR-5.2)
Step 1: Select Outstanding Invoices (FR-4.1.2, FR-4.1.3, FR-5.2)
[Invoice paid, resolved, written off or not yet activated]
Day 3 and day 5 = calendar days after issueDate.
Periodic overdue = after dueDate at configured intervals.
Cancelled accounts still receive reminders for
unpaid historical invoices; new billing stays frozen.
Concurrent attempts return the same record.
[Claim denied, already sent or currently in flight]
Another scheduler owns the dispatch lease,
or this reminder has already been sent.
